video_title: Lou Takes Jalen Brunson OVER Luka Doncic To Win A Championship

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams prefers Jalen Brunson over Luka Doncic for winning a title
quotes.excerpt: I'm rolling with Antonio Daniels. I'm a vibe check guy and I want my guy to have a certain level of aggression.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I'm not mad at Antonio Daniels feeling like he would take Brunson over Luka if it came down to winning a title. Luka has had an opportunity to win a title, Brunson has put himself in the position to win a title as well. It comes down to what do you prefer? You prefer the guy that led the league in scoring? I would prefer Brunson because I'm a vibe check guy. I'm going to keep saying it, I'm a vibe check guy and I want my guy to have a certain level of aggression that matches with the play when he goes out there and performs, and I think Brunson does that for me. So I'm rolling with Daniels.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Answer me this, if Luka was on the Knicks, would they still be in the conference finals right now? No. I completely disagree. I think if Jalen Brunson was on the Lakers, I think they'd still be out of the playoffs right now.
